text: On March 18, 2019, the Nominating Panel - Toronto Licensing Tribunal conducted interviews and recommended 7 candidates, including one as Chair, to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal.

City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidate to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal, who will serve as Chair, for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed: - Mary Lee 2. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal who will serve as public members, for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022, and until successors are appointed: - Anu Bakshi - Maureen Carter-Whitney - Verlyn Francis - Melina Laverty - Edgar-Andre Montigny - Daphne Simon 3. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 5 to the report (March 7, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal.
